scope: Prior-art investigation for adaptive, universal, cross-dataset and tabular learning relevant to CARDIODIAG.
verification_policy: Primary paper or official project source is required for VERIFIED_PRIMARY_SOURCE. Abstract-level records are not treated as full architectural verification. Missing metadata is null, not inferred.

records.name: Mosaic / MOSAIC
records.title: Automated Machine Learning with Monte-Carlo Tree Search
records.venue: arXiv; publication status not independently verified here
records.unseen_dataset_support: Dataset-level search/warm start, not zero-shot prediction
records.adaptation_mechanism: Monte-Carlo tree search over pipeline structure and hyperparameters; optional warm starts and ensemble of discovered solutions
records.training_requirement: Runs dataset-specific search and validation
records.reported_scope: OpenML 100 benchmark; exact dataset count and metric details require full-paper verification
records.relevant_findings: Direct prior art for automated dataset-specific learning-strategy selection. It is not a pretrained universal predictor.

records.name: MOSAIC
records.title: MOSAIC, a comparison framework for machine learning models
records.tabular_support: Generic framework; not a tabular learner
records.unseen_dataset_support: No model-level claim
records.adaptation_mechanism: Configuration-driven model/data execution, run management and metrics storage
records.training_requirement: User supplies models and datasets
records.reported_scope: Framework paper; not a universal prediction algorithm
records.relevant_findings: Name collision with AutoML Mosaic. It must not be cited as evidence for a new adaptive predictor.

records.name: MOSAIC
records.title: MOSAIC: Modular Orchestration for Structured Agentic Intelligence and Composition
records.tabular_support: Structured-data workflow claims; evaluated on financial time-series tasks in the abstract
records.unseen_dataset_support: Claims memory-grounded case retrieval, not verified zero-shot model prediction
records.adaptation_mechanism: Semantic task profile, retrieved cases/modules, intermediate blueprint, execution feedback and failure-aware refinement
records.training_requirement: Agentic search and execution; exact compute and data requirements not verified
records.reported_scope: Financial time-series forecasting and generation
records.relevant_findings: Closest current name match to a dataset-intelligence/orchestration direction, but preprint-only and not a cardiovascular tabular foundation model.

records.name: SageNet
records.title: Supervised spatial inference of dissociated single-cell data with SageNet
authors: Exact author list not fully captured in this audit
records.tabular_support: No; gene-expression matrices are not the CARDIODIAG tabular setting
records.unseen_dataset_support: Maps query cells to trained spatial references; not general-purpose tabular transfer
records.adaptation_mechanism: Reference-derived gene interaction graph and GNN mapping
records.training_requirement: Reference spatial data and labels/partitions
records.reported_scope: Spatial transcriptomics datasets and technologies
records.relevant_findings: A different SageNet from genomics, cosmology, depth estimation and few-shot segmentation.

records.name: SAGE-net
records.title: A scalable approach to investigating sequence-to-function predictions of personal genomes
records.venue: Preprint; later publication status requires separate verification
records.unseen_dataset_support: Unseen individuals/alleles are studied; not arbitrary tabular schemas
records.adaptation_mechanism: Personal-genome training and contrastive separation of mean and personal components
records.training_requirement: Genomic sequences and expression/methylation data
records.reported_scope: ROSMAP, GTEx and related genomic settings
records.relevant_findings: Official code exists, but this is not a general-purpose tabular learner.

records.name: SageNet
records.title: SageNet: Fast Neural Network Emulation of the Stiff-amplified Gravitational Waves from Inflation
records.tabular_support: No; inputs are cosmological parameters and spectra
records.unseen_dataset_support: Generalizes over parameter configurations in its simulator domain
records.adaptation_mechanism: Neural emulation of an expensive numerical solver
records.training_requirement: 25,689 generated solutions according to the abstract
records.reported_scope: Inflationary gravitational-wave spectra
records.relevant_findings: Name collision; irrelevant to universal tabular prediction.

records.name: CrossAdapt
records.title: Efficient Cross-Architecture Knowledge Transfer for Large-Scale Online User Response Prediction
records.tabular_support: Structured user-response features; not arbitrary heterogeneous clinical tables
records.unseen_dataset_support: Transfers between architectures and adapts to streaming distribution changes
records.adaptation_mechanism: Dimension-adaptive embedding projection, progressive distillation, asymmetric co-distillation and shift-aware online weighting
records.training_requirement: Large-scale historical data, teacher model and online stream
records.reported_scope: Three public datasets and a Tencent WeChat Channels deployment according to the abstract
records.relevant_findings: Relevant to online domain shift, but not a zero-shot predictor or dataset-independent cardiovascular model.

records.name: AutoIRAD

records.adaptation_mechanism: Not verified
records.training_requirement: Not verified

records.name: TabPFN
records.title: TabPFN: A Transformer That Solves Small Tabular Classification Problems in a Second
records.venue: ICLR 2023 presentation; later Nature work exists
records.tabular_support: Yes; primarily small numerical classification in the original work
records.unseen_dataset_support: Yes, in-context adaptation to new tasks without parameter updates within model limits
records.adaptation_mechanism: Transformer approximating Bayesian inference over synthetic prior-data-fitted tasks
records.training_requirement: Offline synthetic pretraining; target inference supplies labeled context
records.reported_scope: 18 OpenML-CC18 datasets plus 67 additional small numerical datasets in the abstract
records.relevant_findings: Already solves a strong form of zero-shot/few-shot tabular adaptation for a restricted regime; calibration and distribution shift remain separate concerns.
records.source_depth: Primary paper metadata, abstract and official repository

records.name: TabPFN v2

authors: TabPFN/AutoML group; exact version-specific author record not isolated

records.adaptation_mechanism: Pretrained tabular transformer with target data supplied in context

records.name: TabICL
records.title: TabICL: A Tabular Foundation Model for In-Context Learning on Large Data
records.tabular_support: Yes; mixed tabular support requires implementation-specific inspection
records.unseen_dataset_support: Yes; pretrained synthetic-task prior and context-based prediction
records.adaptation_mechanism: Column-then-row attention, fixed-dimensional row embeddings and transformer ICL
records.training_requirement: Offline synthetic pretraining; no target parameter updates for ICL
records.reported_scope: 200 TALENT classification datasets; 53 datasets over 10K samples in the abstract
records.relevant_findings: Directly addresses cross-dataset prediction at larger scale than original TabPFN; strong prior art against AURA's universal-predictor goal.

records.name: TabM
records.title: TabM: Advancing Tabular Deep Learning with Parameter-Efficient Ensembling
records.unseen_dataset_support: No special zero-shot or cross-dataset mechanism claimed
records.adaptation_mechanism: Shared-parameter implicit ensemble producing multiple predictions per object
records.training_requirement: Supervised target-dataset training
records.reported_scope: Large public tabular benchmark in the paper; exact count requires full-paper extraction
records.relevant_findings: Strong baseline architecture, but not a universal learner. Its ensemble diversity is relevant to reliability experiments.

records.name: TabDPT
records.title: TabDPT: Scaling Tabular Foundation Models on Real Data
records.unseen_dataset_support: Yes; in-context adaptation to unseen data tables
records.adaptation_mechanism: Self-supervised pretraining with real data and ICL/retrieval components
records.training_requirement: Large pretraining corpus; target inference is training-free or light adaptation depending on release
records.reported_scope: CC18 classification and CTR23 regression according to abstract
records.relevant_findings: Real-data pretraining is already an established route to universal tabular behavior; not a gap for AURA to claim alone.
records.source_depth: Primary metadata/abstract and official inference/training links

records.name: APT
records.title: Zero-shot Meta-learning for Tabular Prediction Tasks with Adversarially Pre-trained Transformer
records.unseen_dataset_support: Yes; explicitly zero-shot on new tabular tasks
records.adaptation_mechanism: Adversarial synthetic-data agents shift their generating distributions during pretraining; mixture block supports arbitrary class counts
records.training_requirement: Offline adversarial synthetic pretraining; no target fine-tuning for zero-shot mode
records.reported_scope: Classification and regression benchmark suites; exact counts require full paper
records.relevant_findings: Directly overlaps AURA's universal/adaptive objective and weakens novelty of dataset-intelligence-only proposals.
records.source_depth: Primary metadata/abstract; code availability not verified

records.name: Mitra
records.title: Mitra: Mixed Synthetic Priors for Enhancing Tabular Foundation Models
records.venue: NeurIPS 2025 according to arXiv comment; verify proceedings record before publication claim
records.unseen_dataset_support: Yes; synthetic-prior ICL
records.adaptation_mechanism: Curated mixture of synthetic priors selected for diversity, distinctiveness and real-data performance
records.training_requirement: Offline pretraining; weights released; target adaptation depends on inference/fine-tuning mode
records.reported_scope: Classification and regression benchmarks; exact dataset count not taken from abstract
records.relevant_findings: Prior design itself is a major established research axis. AURA cannot claim mixed-prior adaptation as new without a distinct mechanism.
records.source_depth: Primary metadata/abstract and official model release

records.name: HyperFast

records.unseen_dataset_support: Yes; generates a task-specific network for an unseen dataset
records.adaptation_mechanism: Meta-trained hypernetwork maps dataset/training information to classifier parameters
records.training_requirement: Offline meta-training; target inference avoids conventional target model training
records.reported_scope: OpenML and genomic data according to abstract
records.relevant_findings: Direct prior art for dataset-conditioned model generation; AURA's adaptive model selection is not novel by itself.

records.name: CARTE

records.reported_scope: Extensive benchmark; exact dataset count not copied from abstract
records.relevant_findings: Strong prior art for schema-heterogeneous cross-table transfer. Any new schema adaptation claim must differentiate from CARTE.
